name: Radical
source:
Classmates urge Kazuya to insult a woman. After succeeding in that he goes down this path chasing other women.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
同学们怂恿和也去凌辱一名女子。得手后，他就此走上不断猎取其他女人的道路。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vndb-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
